newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as dollars abound.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as dollars abound.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 470.00/471.00 per dollar as dollars flooded the market in a pattern traders saw continuing into next week.
"Demand for dollars was flat, supply was strong, and next week the bolivar might even firm on that," said one trader who added the Central Bank had not intervened during the day's session.
Traders said Central Bank foreign reserves look set to continue rising. "With that, I expect dollar supplies to the market to continue," said one trader.
Venezuelan foreign reserves rose $477 million in the week to November 11 according to Central Bank figures released Friday.
